outcome: risk factors for premature rupture of membranes complicated by sepsis
diagnostic value of platelet/lymphocyte ratio and neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio in sepsis complicated by premature rupture of membranes
cohort: 99 children with premature rupture of membranes and sepsis and 99 children with premature rupture of membranes without sepsis
finding: Platelet/lymphocyte ratio and neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio have a high predictive value for premature rupture of membranes complicated by sepsis, with platelet/lymphocyte ratio having a greater predictive value than neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was an independent risk factor for premature rupture of membranes complicated by sepsis.
